name: Banh su se
summary: Bánh su sê is tapioca flour, coconut, mung bean, and pomelo-flower water, molded in a fresh coconut leaf. The shape stands for love and fidelity.
origin: A Da Nang cake, sold with bánh ít lá gai.
culture: The coconut-leaf shell stands for love and fidelity.
howToEat: Eat the cake in its coconut-leaf mold.
where: In Da Nang, beside bánh ít lá gai.
